تناسبت (form VI)
# تَنَاسَبْتُ (tanāsabtu) /ta.naː.sab.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاسَبَ (tanāsaba)
# تَنَاسَبْتَ (tanāsabta) /ta.naː.sab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاسَبَ (tanāsaba)
# تَنَاسَبْتِ (tanāsabti) /ta.naː.sab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاسَبَ (tanāsaba)
# تَنَاسَبَتْ (tanāsabat) /ta.naː.sa.bat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
